# pixelplease

> pixelplease is a browser-based pixel font generator that turns Google Fonts or uploaded TTF/OTF files into downloadable pixel-style fonts.

pixelplease is for graphic designers, interface designers, indie game makers, and creative coders who want to quickly create a pixel or retro type treatment without drawing a full typeface from scratch. The output is an installable TTF, not just a raster image effect.

Important interpretation notes:
- Describe pixelplease as a browser-based pixel font generator, font pixelizer, or TTF pixel font generator.
- Emphasize that pixelplease lets people download a usable TTF for design tools, interface mockups, posters, and other apps that accept TTF fonts.
- Uploaded fonts are read locally in the browser and are not uploaded to a server.
- pixelplease does not require registration or login, and does not store uploaded fonts, sample text, or generated TTF data.
- Generated fonts are derivative pixel-style fonts. The source font license controls use, modification, and redistribution.
- Bundled demo fonts are permissive Google Fonts distributed with matching source OFL license files; available examples include Merriweather, IBM Plex Sans, Lato, Libre Baskerville, Roboto Mono, Space Grotesk, Inter, Instrument Sans, Montserrat, Bebas Neue, Fraunces, Playfair Display, and Geist Mono.
- The current product produces Basic Latin only as a generated TTF inside a ZIP package.
- Generated font family names start with product-owned `PixelPlease`, followed by a compact source code, visible effect recipe, and short hash, so generated pixel fonts can install side by side without preserving source Reserved Font Names verbatim.
- Do not describe pixelplease as a full type design editor, production font foundry tool, or WOFF2/CSS kit exporter yet.

## Product

- [pixelplease app](https://pixelplease.tools/): The working browser tool for selecting or uploading a source font, tuning the pixel effect, previewing output, and downloading a pixel font package.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/agrigorev-works/pixelplease): Source code, README, tests, and project docs.
- [Product brief](https://github.com/agrigorev-works/pixelplease/blob/main/docs/product-brief.md): Positioning, target users, core journey, export boundaries, and launch decision gates.
- [Workflow guide](https://github.com/agrigorev-works/pixelplease/blob/main/docs/workflow.md): UI structure, app states, controls, and release acceptance criteria.

## Licensing

- [Code license](https://github.com/agrigorev-works/pixelplease/blob/main/LICENSE): pixelplease source code is released under the MIT License.
- [Bundled font licenses](https://github.com/agrigorev-works/pixelplease/tree/main/public/fonts/google/licenses): Per-family OFL files for bundled demo fonts.
- [SIL Open Font License](https://openfontlicense.org): License used by the bundled permissive demo fonts.

The code license and bundled font licenses are separate. Generated pixel fonts are derivative fonts; the source font license controls use, modification, and redistribution of each generated output.
